Body lice diverged from head lice 40,000 years ago
Body lice cannot survive outside clothing
Head lice are a subspecies of body lice
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that transcriptome analyses found 'body and head lice were almost genetically identical.'
Incorrect. The 40,000 to 170,000 year estimate comes from earlier louse speciation studies, not the transcriptome analyses that cast doubt on dating.
Incorrect. While true, this statement is not what the transcriptome analyses found about the genetic relationship.
Incorrect. The article describes them as sibling subspecies, not one being a subspecies of the other.

Incorrect. Selling remnants as waste describes modern European fashion and industrial sewing, not traditional conservative patterns.
Incorrect. The article does not mention using only synthetic fibers for fabric conservation.
